extraction.name: VoiceAssistant-Eval
extraction.description: VoiceAssistant-Eval comprises 10,497 curated examples spanning 13 task categories. These tasks include natural sounds, music, and spoken dialogue for listening; multi-tum dialogue, role-play imitation, and various scenarios for speaking; and highly heterogeneous images for viewing.
extraction.creator: Ke Wang, Houxing Ren, Zimu Lu, Mingjie Zhan, Hongsheng Li
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by extracting visual and auditory inputs from 37 existing datasets, synthesizing speech for question texts using TTS models, and applying a multi-stage curation process.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Visual and auditory inputs from 37 datasets, including natural sounds, music, dialogue, and various images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The content was de-duplicated using lexical overlap and edit-distance matching, followed by filtering out incomplete or inappropriate items such as missing audio/images or ill-posed questions.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, F5-TTS, ChatTTS, Dia-1.6B, UTMOS Strong, Whisper-Large-v3
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will maintain a data governance process for auditing and removal, reserving the right to update assets if consent or licensing concerns arise.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset includes measures to enable research on personalization while minimizing harms related to impersonation, privacy violations, and unequal performance across demographics.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may carry biases from its source data and design choices, such as the role-play subset using a fixed set of 100 roles that may encode stereotypes or omit important user personas.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited in linguistic diversity (mostly English), evaluates a limited range of models, relies on automated measures and GPT-based scoring which may introduce noise, and evaluates models in an offline, static manner without capturing real-time deployment factors.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating voice assistants and facilitating future studies in this area.

name.evidence: We introduce VoiceAssistant-Eval , a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess AI assistants across listening, speaking, and viewing.

description.evidence: VoiceAssistant-Eval comprises 10,497 curated examples spanning 13 task categories. These tasks include natural sounds, music, and spoken dialogue for listening; multi-tum dialogue, role-play imitation, and various scenarios for speaking; and highly heterogeneous images for viewing.

inLanguage.evidence: Although we include five Chinese roles in the role-play task, all other prompts and evaluations are in English.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: When collecting test data, we first extract diverse visual and auditory inputs from 37 datasets, including natural sounds, music, dialogue, and various images.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: When collecting test data, we first extract diverse visual and auditory inputs from 37 datasets, including natural sounds, music, dialogue, and various images.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: When collecting test data, we first extract diverse visual and auditory inputs from 37 datasets, including natural sounds, music, dialogue, and various images.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: First, we de-duplicate the content using a combination of lexical overlap and edit-distance matching. Next, we filter out incomplete or inappropriate items, including cases with missing or broken audio or images, as well as instances with ill-posed questions or incorrect answers.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: We use Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (Qwen et al., 2025) to rewrite the text so it is more suitable for TTS... We synthesize speech for question texts using three advanced text-to-speech (TTS) models: F5TTS (Chen et al., 2024b), ChatTTS (Team, 2025), and Dia-1.6B (Sung et al., 2025)... we use UTMOS Strong (Saeki et al., 2022) to evaluate the generated speech... Finally, we use Whisper-Large-v3 (Radford et al., 2022) to transcribe the synthesized audio back into text

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: We will maintain a data govemance process for auditing and removal and reserve the right to update assets if consent or licensing concems arise.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: These measures aim to enable research on personalization while minimizing harms related to impersonation, privacy violations, and unequal performance across demographics.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: The questions and contexts are drawn from academic or synthetic sources (e.g., existing datasets and rewritten instructions), which might not reflect the full richness or faimess concems of real deployments. For example, the role-play subset uses a fixed set of 100 roles and associated style prompts. These roles may encode stereotypes or omit important user personas.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: First, the dataset, though sizable (10.5K curated QA items), may still be limited in diversity... Second, the range of models evaluated in our study is limited... Third, our evaluation methodology has limitations... Fifth, although we span 13 task categories, there remain gaps in task coverage and scenario realism... Finally, VoiceAssistant-Eval evaluates models in an offline, static manner, which might not capture certain practical deployment factors.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We intend for researchers to use this dataset to better evaluate voice assistants and, consequently, facilitate future studies in this area.
